brands.evidence: For most people, the free account or Perks is enough.

client_claims.text: Extra is £3 a month, Perks is £9 and Max is £19.
client_claims.note: Matches the listed plan prices (Max is 'from £19').

client_claims.text: Perks went up from £7 and Max from £17. Extra didn't change.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover previous prices.

client_claims.text: Max has a 3-month minimum and is for ages 18-69.
Perks includes an annual Railcard, Uber One, a weekly Greggs treat and a monthly Vue cinema ticket.
client_claims.note: Perk contents are not in the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo says the partner perks are worth over £300 a year.
Max has a 0.75-point savings rate uplift.
client_claims.note: Facts only give the free plan rate of 2.80%.

client_claims.text: Max buys worldwide multi-trip travel insurance, phone insurance and RAC cover.
Adding family costs an extra £4 a month.
The free account gives you spending categories, pots and basic roundups.
